Usage: android emulator create [-h] [--list-profiles] [<profile>]
Creates a virtual device

Options:
  -h, --help           Show the help message for this command
      --list-profiles  lists the device profiles that can be used to create a
                       device

android options:
      --sdk=PARAM      Path to the Android SDK
  -v, --verbose        Enable verbose output for troubleshooting
  -V, --version        Print version information and exit

Positional Parameters:
  <profile>  Create a device with a specified profile. Creates the appropriate
             device for the selected profile (i.e. watch, phone, XR, etc)
